scripts.build: npm run build:workspaces && npm run check:build-output
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace @codexsun/framework && npm run build --workspace @codexsun/platform-core-api && npm run build --workspace @codexsun/platform-api
scripts.build:zetro: npm run build --workspace @codexsun/zetro-web && npm run build --workspace @codexsun/zetro-api
scripts.test:zetro: npm run test:history --workspace @codexsun/zetro-api && npm run test:workflow --workspace @codexsun/zetro-api && npm run test:worktree --workspace @codexsun/zetro-api
scripts.test:e2e:server: npm run build:api && node --test tools/platform-api-composition.test.mjs tools/e2e/server-lifecycle.e2e.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:workspace-layout && npm run check:lines && npm run check:app-docs && npm run check:module-docs && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:framework && npm run test:platform-web && npm run test:e2e:server
